chunks: Thus the truth was upheld, and the falsehood that they practised was exposed.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the truth is upheld and falsehood is exposed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the decisive moment when divine decree (Hukm) overrides human agency, confirming that truth (Al-Haqq) is not merely a concept but an active force that nullifies the works of the disbelievers. It underscores the futility of worldly power when measured against eternal reality, a theme central to the concept of Divine Justice (Adl).
